note: Designed sounds for the Crownfall opening, made with Stable Audio (Soundbox + audio.cpp) and checked by ear with earshot. Each is placed from the film's own timing: 'at' names a narration cue (cue: 'L06', edge 'start' or 'end'), a scene (scene: 4), the studio card (studio), the YEAR 33 card (year33) or the title (title), plus an offset in seconds. 'align' says whether the sound starts on that moment or ends on it. 'gain' is linear, before the mix. 'check' is what earshot should hear; 'not' are the confusions it must rank lower.
